physical_mappings.description: List of physical network interface → physical network mappings. Each entry maps a host’s physical NIC to a Neutron physical network name (e.g., 'eth0 physnet1').

physical_interface.description: Name of the physical network interface on the host (e.g., 'eth0', 'ens3f0')

physical_network.description: Name of the corresponding Neutron physical network (e.g., 'physnet1', 'provider')

virtual_interface_type.description: Type of virtual interface to use for guest VMs. Supported: 'veth', 'macvtap', 'bridge' (legacy).

vxlan_udp_port.description: UDP port to use for VXLAN overlay traffic. Standard is 4789 (RFC 7348).

enable_vxlan.description: Enable VXLAN as the overlay network type (requires underlying L2 reachability or unicast/multicast support).

multicast_group.description: Multicast group address (e.g., '239.1.1.1') for VXLAN broadcast replication in multicast mode. Required only if enable_vxlan and using multicast.

local_ip.description: Local IP address of the node’s overlay network interface. Required for unicast VXLAN (when no multicast is available).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level. Options: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL.

log_dir.description: Directory where log files will be stored.

enable_security_group.description: Enable security groups (iptables or nftables firewall rules for VMs). Required for tenant isolation.

firewall_driver.description: Firewall driver implementation. Common values: iptables (default), nftables, or noop (disabled).

enable_hairpin.description: Enable hairpinning: allow VMs to reach themselves via floating IPs through the router.

dhcp_broadcast.description: Enable suppression of broadcast DHCP traffic between ports on the same network (improves security).

port_security.description: Enable port security extension — prevents MAC/IP spoofing by enforcing allowed address pairs.

polling_interval.description: Number of seconds between device polling loops (e.g., to detect port changes). Lower = more responsive but higher CPU.

min_retry_interval.description: Minimum seconds to wait between failed device creation/retry attempts.

max_retry_interval.description: Maximum seconds to wait between retry attempts (exponential backoff cap).

enable_dhcp_notification.description: Enable DHCP agent notifications for HA DHCP (used when multiple DHCP agents are coordinated).

enable_metadata_proxy.description: Enable the metadata proxy service (required for instance metadata access via Neutron metadata service).

metadata_proxy_shared_secret.description: Shared secret (string) used to authenticate metadata proxy requests to the Neutron metadata service. Should match neutron.conf.

bridge_mapping.description: Legacy alias for physical_interface_mappings — prefer physical_mappings. Format: 'physnet1:br-eth0'.

linux_bridge_path.description: Path to the Linux bridge utilities (for legacy compatibility).
